title: IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) message
summary: IGMP is used by hosts to report multicast group memberships to routers. Message types: 0x11 (Membership Query), 0x12 (Version 1 Membership Report), 0x16 (Version 2 Membership Report), 0x17 (Leave Group), 0x22 (Version 3 Membership Report). IGMPv3 supports source filtering (include/exclude sources). IGMP messages are carried in IP (protocol 2).

structure.meaning: 0x11 Membership Query, 0x12 V1 Report, 0x16 V2 Report, 0x17 Leave Group, 0x22 V3 Report.
For queries: max time (in 1/10 seconds) for hosts to respond. 0 for reports.
Standard IP checksum of the IGMP message.
For queries: multicast group to query (0.0.0.0 = general query). For reports: group being reported.
Number of group records + group records (record type, aux data length, number of sources, multicast address, source addresses).
1 = MODE_IS_INCLUDE, 2 = MODE_IS_EXCLUDE, 3 = CHANGE_TO_INCLUDE_MODE, 4 = CHANGE_TO_EXCLUDE_MODE, 5 = ALLOW_NEW_SOURCES, 6 = BLOCK_OLD_SOURCES.

notes: IGMP is used for multicast group management (IPTV, video conferencing, etc.).
IGMP snooping: switches learn multicast group memberships to avoid flooding.
MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) is the IPv6 equivalent of IGMP.
